qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: While Elisa achieves stellar capital efficiency for a telecom (17.7% median GAAP ROIC, ~48% tangible ROIC) via network automation and software, mature Finnish unlimited-data plan competition prevented above-inflation pricing: nominal Owner EPS declined -1.2%/yr over 2022–2025 during >16% cumulative Eurozone inflation.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Lacks above-inflation pricing power, REJECT). Europe's highest-quality, best-managed telco with 17.7% ROIC and >100% cash conversion, but fails Gate 3b as mature Finnish telecom subscriptions could not keep pace with 2022–2025 inflation (nominal Owner EPS fell -1.2%/yr despite >16% cumulative inflation).
qualitative.evidence: Reported GAAP ROIC of 16.5–18.1% (median 17.65%) and FCF conversion of 102% demonstrate industry-leading operational excellence. However, Net Income fell from €374M in 2022 to €342M in 2025 and Owner EPS declined from €2.33 to €2.25 despite >16% Eurozone inflation, proving that fierce 3-player domestic competition caps real pricing power.
